def check_constraints():
    from z3 import Int, Function, IntSort, Solver
    
    ectx = Int('ectx')
    num_encoders = Function('OSSL_ENCODER_CTX_get_num_encoders', IntSort(), IntSort())
    
    s = Solver()
    s.add(ectx == 0)
    s.add(num_encoders(ectx) != 0)
    
    return s.check() == sat
